conclusion: Sharp-tip and sharp-tail contact exceptions should be limited to genuinely elongated support regions (at least a 4:1 aspect ratio on any source polygon) whose contact footprint exceeds 1.85 times the original overhang area. Generic closed TopInterface paths must not be deleted by this policy; closed-path trimming is restricted to TopContact.
